create_init_project: init a new Label Studio project with a user, label config, and sampling strategy
create_start_server: start the Label Studio web server on a specified host and port with auto-free-port detection
create_reset_password: reset a user's password by email address with interactive or command-line input
create_export_project: export a Label Studio project's labeled data to a specified format and output path
create_get_user_info: retrieve user info and authentication token by email address from the Label Studio database
